title: volatile-only thread flags are not memory-safe on ARM/MIPS
description:
g_event_thread_running and g_flash_thread_running in wp11_pkcs11.c are declared volatile and written by the main thread, read by background threads. volatile prevents compiler reordering but provides no hardware memory barrier. On weakly-ordered architectures (ARM, MIPS) a store from one core may not be visible to another core in time. Thread sees stale value, exits late or never.

Fix: replace with C11 atomic_int (stdatomic.h) or a pthread_mutex + condition variable for the exit signal. Add comment explaining why atomic is required (not just volatile).
